title: My pipes
intro: Every pipe has a story. Keep its details, memories and photographs.
emptyText: Add your first pipe to start your catalogue.
footnote: Functional prototype V1 · Data is stored only in this browser. Cloud storage is not available yet: do not use this version as your only archive for important data. You can export and import a JSON backup.
choosePhoto: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo (max 3 MB)
deleteConfirm: Permanently delete {{name}}? This action cannot be undone.
importConfirm: Import {{count}} pipes? Your current collection will be replaced.
recoveryConfirm: The current data cannot be read. Download the original data first to preserve it. Replace it with this backup?
photoInvalid: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP file up to 3 MB.
storageRead: Unable to read stored data. The original data has not been changed. Download it for recovery or import a valid backup.
storageWrite: Unable to save. Browser storage may be full: export your data and try smaller photos.
importError: Import failed: invalid format or data (maximum 20 MB, no duplicate IDs).
rawError: Unable to access the original browser data.
soonText: This module will be available in a future milestone.
